measures.name: Home v2 | Track Value
measures.expression:
VAR _n = COALESCE([PMO | Plans Reported Off Track], 0)
RETURN FORMAT(_n, "0") & " off track"

measures.name: Home v2 | Track Status
measures.expression:
VAR _n = COALESCE([PMO | Plans Reported Off Track], 0)
RETURN IF(ISBLANK([PMO | Plans Reported Off Track]), "● No data", IF(_n > 2, "● Act now", IF(_n > 0, "● Watch", "● On track")))

measures.name: Home v2 | Track Colour
measures.expression:
VAR _n = COALESCE([PMO | Plans Reported Off Track], 0)
RETURN IF(ISBLANK([PMO | Plans Reported Off Track]), "#8A96B0", IF(_n > 2, "#F0616D", IF(_n > 0, "#F2A33A", "#3FB97A")))

measures.name: Home v2 | Track Insight
measures.expression:
VAR _l = COALESCE([Task | Active Late Tasks], 0)
RETURN "plans reported off track · " & FORMAT(_l, "#,0") & " late tasks still open"

measures.name: Home v2 | Cost Value
measures.expression:
VAR _b = [Finance | Budget Cost]
VAR _f = [Finance | Forecast Cost]
VAR _p = DIVIDE(_f - _b, _b)
RETURN IF(ISBLANK(_p), "–", FORMAT(_p, "+0.0%;-0.0%;0.0%") & " vs budget")

measures.name: Home v2 | Cost Status
measures.expression:
VAR _b = [Finance | Budget Cost]
VAR _f = [Finance | Forecast Cost]
VAR _p = DIVIDE(_f - _b, _b)
RETURN IF(ISBLANK(_p), "● No data", IF(_p > 0.05, "● Over budget", IF(_p > 0, "● Watch", "● Within budget")))

measures.name: Home v2 | Cost Colour
measures.expression:
VAR _b = [Finance | Budget Cost]
VAR _f = [Finance | Forecast Cost]
VAR _p = DIVIDE(_f - _b, _b)
RETURN IF(ISBLANK(_p), "#8A96B0", IF(_p > 0.05, "#F0616D", IF(_p > 0, "#F2A33A", "#3FB97A")))

measures.name: Home v2 | Cost Insight
measures.expression:
VAR _mf = [Finance | Forecast Cost]
VAR _mb = [Finance | Budget Cost]
RETURN "Forecast " & IF(ISBLANK(_mf), "–", "€" & IF(ABS(_mf) >= 1000000, FORMAT(_mf / 1000000, "#,0.0") & "M", IF(ABS(_mf) >= 1000, FORMAT(_mf / 1000, "#,0") & "k", FORMAT(_mf, "#,0")))) & " against budget " & IF(ISBLANK(_mb), "–", "€" & IF(ABS(_mb) >= 1000000, FORMAT(_mb / 1000000, "#,0.0") & "M", IF(ABS(_mb) >= 1000, FORMAT(_mb / 1000, "#,0") & "k", FORMAT(_mb, "#,0"))))

measures.name: Home v2 | Risk Value
measures.expression:
VAR _r = COALESCE([Project | Active Risks], 0)
RETURN FORMAT(_r, "0") & " active risks"

measures.name: Home v2 | Risk Status
measures.expression:
VAR _r = COALESCE([Project | Active Risks], 0)
RETURN IF(ISBLANK([Project | Active Risks]), "● No data", IF(_r > 5, "● Act now", IF(_r > 0, "● Watch", "● Clear")))

measures.name: Home v2 | Risk Colour
measures.expression:
VAR _r = COALESCE([Project | Active Risks], 0)
RETURN IF(ISBLANK([Project | Active Risks]), "#8A96B0", IF(_r > 5, "#F0616D", IF(_r > 0, "#F2A33A", "#3FB97A")))

measures.name: Home v2 | Risk Insight
measures.expression: FORMAT(COALESCE([Project | Active Issues], 0), "0") & " open issues · exposure " & FORMAT(COALESCE([Risk & Issue | Total Risk Exposure], 0), "#,0")

measures.name: Home v2 | People Value
measures.expression:
VAR _o = COALESCE([Capacity | Over-Allocated Resource Count], 0)
RETURN FORMAT(_o, "0") & " over-allocated"

measures.name: Home v2 | People Status
measures.expression:
VAR _o = COALESCE([Capacity | Over-Allocated Resource Count], 0)
RETURN IF(ISBLANK([Capacity | Demand]), "● No data", IF(_o > 3, "● Act now", IF(_o > 0, "● Watch", "● Covered")))

measures.name: Home v2 | People Colour
measures.expression:
VAR _o = COALESCE([Capacity | Over-Allocated Resource Count], 0)
RETURN IF(ISBLANK([Capacity | Demand]), "#8A96B0", IF(_o > 3, "#F0616D", IF(_o > 0, "#F2A33A", "#3FB97A")))

measures.name: Home v2 | People Insight
measures.expression: "Demand " & FORMAT(COALESCE([Capacity | Demand], 0), "#,0") & " h · " & FORMAT(COALESCE([Capacity | Availability], 0), "#,0") & " h still available"

measures.name: Home v2 | Fund Value
measures.expression:
VAR _pb = [Modeler | Portfolio Budget]
VAR _tb = [Modeler | Target Budget]
VAR _mp = _pb
RETURN IF(ISBLANK(_mp), "–", "€" & IF(ABS(_mp) >= 1000000, FORMAT(_mp / 1000000, "#,0.0") & "M", IF(ABS(_mp) >= 1000, FORMAT(_mp / 1000, "#,0") & "k", FORMAT(_mp, "#,0")))) & " selected"

measures.name: Home v2 | Fund Status
measures.expression:
VAR _pb = [Modeler | Portfolio Budget]
VAR _tb = [Modeler | Target Budget]
RETURN IF(ISBLANK(_pb) || ISBLANK(_tb), "● No data", IF(_pb > _tb * 1.05, "● Over target", IF(_pb > _tb, "● At the limit", "● Fits target")))

measures.name: Home v2 | Fund Colour
measures.expression:
VAR _pb = [Modeler | Portfolio Budget]
VAR _tb = [Modeler | Target Budget]
RETURN IF(ISBLANK(_pb) || ISBLANK(_tb), "#8A96B0", IF(_pb > _tb * 1.05, "#F0616D", IF(_pb > _tb, "#F2A33A", "#3FB97A")))

measures.name: Home v2 | Fund Insight
measures.expression:
VAR _mt = [Modeler | Target Budget]
RETURN "Target " & IF(ISBLANK(_mt), "–", "€" & IF(ABS(_mt) >= 1000000, FORMAT(_mt / 1000000, "#,0.0") & "M", IF(ABS(_mt) >= 1000, FORMAT(_mt / 1000, "#,0") & "k", FORMAT(_mt, "#,0")))) & " · " & FORMAT(COALESCE([Modeler | Misaligned Plan Count], 0), "0") & " plans misaligned to strategy"

measures.name: Home v2 | Payoff Value
measures.expression:
VAR _rate = DIVIDE([Benefits | Realized Benefits], [Benefits | Planned Benefits])
RETURN IF(ISBLANK(_rate), "–", FORMAT(_rate, "0%") & " realized")

measures.name: Home v2 | Payoff Status
measures.expression:
VAR _rate = DIVIDE([Benefits | Realized Benefits], [Benefits | Planned Benefits])
RETURN IF(ISBLANK(_rate), "● No data", IF(_rate < 0.6, "● Well behind", IF(_rate < 0.9, "● Behind plan", "● On plan")))

measures.name: Home v2 | Payoff Colour
measures.expression:
VAR _rate = DIVIDE([Benefits | Realized Benefits], [Benefits | Planned Benefits])
RETURN IF(ISBLANK(_rate), "#8A96B0", IF(_rate < 0.6, "#F0616D", IF(_rate < 0.9, "#F2A33A", "#3FB97A")))

measures.name: Home v2 | Payoff Insight
measures.expression:
VAR _mr = [Benefits | Realized Benefits]
VAR _mpl = [Benefits | Planned Benefits]
RETURN IF(ISBLANK(_mr), "–", "€" & IF(ABS(_mr) >= 1000000, FORMAT(_mr / 1000000, "#,0.0") & "M", IF(ABS(_mr) >= 1000, FORMAT(_mr / 1000, "#,0") & "k", FORMAT(_mr, "#,0")))) & " of " & IF(ISBLANK(_mpl), "–", "€" & IF(ABS(_mpl) >= 1000000, FORMAT(_mpl / 1000000, "#,0.0") & "M", IF(ABS(_mpl) >= 1000, FORMAT(_mpl / 1000, "#,0") & "k", FORMAT(_mpl, "#,0")))) & " planned benefits"

measures.name: Home v2 | Attention
measures.expression:
VAR _a1 = IF([Home v2 | Track Colour] = "#F0616D", [Home v2 | Track Value], "")
VAR _a2 = IF([Home v2 | Cost Colour] = "#F0616D", "Forecast " & [Home v2 | Cost Value], "")
VAR _a3 = IF([Home v2 | Risk Colour] = "#F0616D", [Home v2 | Risk Value], "")
VAR _a4 = IF([Home v2 | People Colour] = "#F0616D", [Home v2 | People Value] & " people", "")
VAR _a5 = IF([Home v2 | Fund Colour] = "#F0616D", "Funding over target", "")
VAR _a6 = IF([Home v2 | Payoff Colour] = "#F0616D", "Benefits " & [Home v2 | Payoff Value], "")
VAR _t = FILTER({ (1, _a1), (2, _a2), (3, _a3), (4, _a4), (5, _a5), (6, _a6) }, [Value2] <> "")
RETURN IF(COUNTROWS(_t) = 0, "All clear · no question needs action today",
    "Needs attention  ▸  " & CONCATENATEX(_t, [Value2], "   ·   ", [Value1], ASC))

measures.name: Home v2 | Attention Colour
measures.expression: IF([Home v2 | Track Colour] = "#F0616D" || [Home v2 | Cost Colour] = "#F0616D" || [Home v2 | Risk Colour] = "#F0616D" || [Home v2 | People Colour] = "#F0616D" || [Home v2 | Fund Colour] = "#F0616D" || [Home v2 | Payoff Colour] = "#F0616D", "#F0616D", "#3FB97A")
